description: This PHP class defines the OpenTag model for managing open tags in the Goteo project, including methods for retrieving, listing, validating, saving, and reordering tags.

classes.name: OpenTag
classes.description: Model class for handling open tags, including CRUD operations, listing, and ordering within the Goteo project.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the fields that are language-dependent, namely 'name' and 'description'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific open tag by ID, supporting language localization.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all open tags with their associated project count, ordered by 'order'.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Gets all open tags used in published projects, grouped and ordered.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the open tag data, ensuring 'name' is not empty.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the open tag data to the database, performing insert or update as needed.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves the open tag up in order.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves the open tag down in order.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order value for adding a new open tag at the end.
